text:
Sam T.: FYI opened docs PR for aurora-quant model card — noticed max_seq still listed as 8k but runtime tests show 6k for 4-bit quant. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/902 :eyes:
Elaine M.: thanks Sam — can you paste the failing command and bench output? we should avoid breaking the published limits
Sam T.: repro command:
```
python bench_runner.py --model aurora-quant-4bit --seq 8000 --batch 1
```
output: tail:
```
RuntimeError: KV cache overflow at step 512 (supports up to 6_144 tokens)
```
Sam T.: PR is at ^ includes updated limit + a short caveat note about quant variants
Raj P.: nice catch. Model team verified: quant artifact uses packed KV layout -> lower seq ceiling. Suggest phrasing: "Quantized variants may have reduced long-context limits; refer to runtime variant table." Also add a short benchmark link
Nick L.: SDK snippet also needs update — our example uses `client.generate(..., max_tokens=7500)` which encourages users to exceed supported seq. I'll open PR to change snippet to use `max_tokens=min(1024, model.max_sequence - prompt_len)` or add a guard
Elaine M.: For docs QA: please add a tiny test file under examples/longctx that runs the bench command and asserts it doesn't crash. docs-bot will run smoke tests
Docs-bot: ci/docs-smoke #902 queued — will run after PR approvals :robot_face:
Sam T.: I'll add the example and tweak the phrasing. Quick question — do we want the caveat on both model card and the catalog limits matrix?
Elaine M.: yes, both. Put a short cross-link: "See catalog limits (https://internal.redwood/models/catalog)" and in catalog add a footnote for quant variants. Keep wording simple
Raj P.: I'll provide the wording and the one-line benchmark digest
Nick L.: merged SDK snippet PR draft, waiting for CI
Sam T.: great — thx everyone :thumbsup:
